name: graph
description: Shortest-path and heuristic-search algorithms for boru (Dijkstra, A*, Floyd-Warshall, Bellman-Ford), to be exposed as the single `Graph` namespace. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED: graph.aql exports an empty namespace. The argued design is in DESIGN.md.

conventions.import: import "./graph.aql" — no `end` needed. A relative import resolves against the directory of the importing file (for both `boru X` and `boru check X`), not the working directory: a suite in test/ imports "../graph.aql".
conventions.call: forward args, receiver (the graph) LAST: `Graph.verb ...args g`. Piping `g Graph.verb ...args` binds identically. Receiver-first all-forward misbinds: `boru check` rejects it when the swapped arguments differ in type (uncalled_function, which also blocks `boru X`); two same-typed args bind silently in signature order.
conventions.heuristic: A heuristic passed to Graph.astar MAY call its own module's helpers: boru resolves a function value's free words in the module that DEFINED it (fixed upstream in boru 7e98aeb, re-verified on boru main @ 64c5ab2, including through a native callback). Pass it as a value, `h/v` — a bare name holding a function calls (`/r` was renamed `/v`). Close over the goal through a parameter rather than a top-level name, which resolves late. See DESIGN.md section 7.
conventions.nodes: Node names are Strings: boru map keys must be String or Atom.
conventions.representation: Weighted adjacency map, {node: {neighbour: weight}}. `{a: {b: 3}}` is an edge a->b of weight 3. Isolated nodes are representable as `{a: {}}`.
conventions.unreachable: Unreachable nodes are ABSENT from the result, never an infinity sentinel (boru raises integer_overflow outside the signed 64-bit range rather than wrapping).
conventions.limits: A run is capped at 10,000,000 evaluation steps by default (evaluation_limit; raise with `boru -options steps:N`): a Floyd-Warshall-shaped V^3 relaxation stops around V=55. See DESIGN.md section 8 note.
